author: TiamatReturn
body:
Once you get to know which adorn to keep and which ones to not keep you can do it fast and easy, what I usually do when I want to clean up is open the adorn tab and start typing keywords for the adorns that you drop a TON of, like the jewel of immortals or the jewels of the deep, I send the ornate ones to the keep and then select all and trash, I do this for all the adorns that I have a lot of copies of. then I send to storage all the adorns that are useful but not for my build like for example the kerb adorns which I do not use as GS but maybe one day I will use and trash the rest, so on and on. Then when most of the named adorns are sorted I type "jewel" and in order of ward and check if there is any of the random generated adorn that is worth keeping.

For gear I wouldn't stress too much, just pay attention to raid drops when you farm a certain event but for what is available everyday just keep the ornate versions and send to your keep if you don't plan using. Every few months you can go through your keep and you will find for example 12 ornate realmspikes (fallen RS drop) then you can just look at the highest stats and trash the rest, I do it this way and It works very well.

Another thing that can help you is to sort your inventory the last day of the month or first day of the month, you can show only exotics and look at that month special drops and decide what to keep and what to trash, doing this will allow you to not lose your mind with a lot of different events drops mixed together.

author: Zanar_Skwigelf
body:
Next to where you set the sort by ward is a green "more" button. Select that and set the quality to broken. Go through the different categories and select all, then junk / dismantle. Set the quality to poor and do the same thing.


Go to your accessories, set the quality to ornate, sort by name, and select everything except 2 copies of each accessory. Junk them. Do the same thing at each quality level. Start at legendary if you can't convince yourself to junk ornate stuff.


Use all of your scrolls, but don't use them at the same time. Personally, I use my scrolls 5 at a time, and then fight 1-5 of them before using the next batch. High enough to get through them somewhat quickly, low enough where I don't feel overwhelmed because I need to do 1 billion damage to visually clear my screen.
